title: Google Pay preps for AI agents with Universal Commerce Protocol
summary: Google Pay is redesigning its payment infrastructure to support transactions from AI agents rather than human users, introducing the Universal Commerce Protocol and new server architecture to position itself as a central clearinghouse for autonomous agent purchases.
problem_solved: Enables AI agents to autonomously execute commercial transactions on behalf of users without human intervention.
why_valuable: Prepares the payment ecosystem for the emerging wave of AI agents that need to make purchases, bookings, and reservations autonomously.
